description.value:
Requirements An adjacent ally is dying.

You give a substantial piece of yourself to bring an adjacent ally back from the brink, breaking a part of your body off to use your restorative body chemistry for emergency aid. Don't increase the value of the target's wounded or dying condition for 1 minute due to the results of recovery checks or losing the dying condition. The targeted creature immediately rolls a recovery check. The target is then immune to Part of Me for You for 24 hours.

Special The frequency of Restorative Tissues becomes once per 10 minutes rather than once per day.
